title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01
lineage: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)
source: Matrix of SBD (shnid=127028): SBD -> Master Reel -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) and AUD (shnid=88528): Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a stellar ’73 show with crystal‑clear guitars and soaring jams like China > I Know You Rider and the massive Truckin’ > Other One > Wharf Rat sequence.
ai_review.review: The Hunter Seamons matrix capture delivers outstanding sonic clarity – the guitars sit in separate channels and the overall mix is crisp, making the long improvisations a real pleasure. Musically the concert shines with a mellow first set that builds into a monster second set highlighted by a blistering China > IKYR jam, an epic Playing in the Band segue into a 41‑minute Truckin’ > Other One > Wharf Rat suite, and tight performances of classics like Sugaree and Loose Lucy.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and praise both the musical performance and the matrix recording’s exceptional clarity; the show is described as a highlight with several epic jams, justifying an above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crystal‑clear guitar separation, crisp overall mix, and no significant dropouts or distortion – a standout matrix capture by Hunter Seamons.

standout_songs: Truckin' > The Other One > Wharf Rat
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is mellow and song‑focused (Half Step, Sugaree, China > IKYR), while the second set launches into a 25‑minute Playing in the Band jam followed by an extended Truckin’ > Other One > Wharf Rat marathon, delivering a classic ’73 Dead experience.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass solo around 6:21 is highlighted as kicking the jam into overdrive, earning special praise for his improvisational drive.
